﻿1. Have the latest version of[color=#6aa84f] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] [/color]installed.
﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿2. Have the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3642]Event Repeater[/url] installed.
﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿4. Download Nature's Bounty and extract the .zip file into your Mods folder.
﻿- If you're using Windows, you'll get 2 folders when you extract: [CP] Nature's Bounty AND _MACOSX.
﻿- This is because I created and uploaded the mod from a Mac.
﻿- You can delete _MACOSX folder and just move the [CP] Nature's Bounty folder into your Mods folder.
﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿5. Run the game using SMAPI.

[/size][/b][center][size=4]Nature's Bounty in it's current state is far from where I imagine it to be. I have a lot of ideas in the works, and I'll release updates as I get the time to bring it all to life. I'm always open to suggestions, so let me know what you'd like to see!

[/size]

﻿
﻿[b][color=#93c47d]More dialogue[/color][/b] as an effect of the Stoned and Skunk buffs, and referring to cannabis in general.

﻿[b][color=#93c47d]Immersion[/color][/b] with SVE - this is currently in progress. RSV immersion is pending permission from the creator.

﻿[b][color=#93c47d]New strains[/color][/b] of marijuana with canon-friendly names (to be revealed!) - 1 sativa, 1 indica, 1 hybrid, and 1 fantasy strain.

﻿[b][color=#93c47d]Psilocybin[/color][/b] as a forageable, craftable item 'dosed shrooms', related cutscenes, quests, and dialogue.

﻿﻿[b][color=#93c47d]Game Mechanic[/color][/b] that allows player to act as a "dealer" to select NPCs. This will be a major update to include new quests, dialogue, recipes, cutscenes. The player will be able to choose between legalizing substances ﻿(which includes getting permits for growing/selling) or keeping it illegal and growing/selling secretly (with penalties for getting caught!). Bear with me on this one, there is a lot going into it and it will take some time. [/size][/center]
